recordSemantics: Asset segments inside the NPWS asset database, not complete named hiking itineraries.
publicationPolicy: All rows remain 待核验. The lines are reference-only, non-navigational, and do not establish access permission, current opening state, safety, or a complete route. Only official Walking Track and Walking Route asset classes are collected; other asset classes are excluded.
collectionPolicy: Complete-source replacement only after every ID page, record, geometry, and ID set validates. A failed or incomplete fetch retains the previous catalog.
